Optimapharm is a mid-sized, global Contract Research Organisation turning science into hope through agile, patient-focused clinical development. the organization Professional growth and continuous learning in an evolving environment Performance-based bonus Referral bonus Flexible working hours and a supportive work environment Training and Experience University degree in Law and 5+ years of relevant legal experience, ideally gained within life sciences, pharma, biotech, CRO or another regulated international environment Strong hands-on expertise in GDPR, data protection and privacy law Previous experience acting as a DPO or holding comparable privacy responsibilities is highly desirable Practical experience with DPIAs, privacy risk assessments, data processing agreements and international data transfers Experience with AI-related privacy matters and a good understanding of the EU AI Act Broad experience across corporate and commercial law, regulatory matters and legal risk management Proven experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements Ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, pragmatic and business-oriented advice for senior and non-legal stakeholders Excellent written and spoken English, together with high professional integrity and sound judgment CIPP/E or a similar data protection certification is an advantage 📑 Your responsibilities Act as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership, providing practical and business-oriented advice on legal, regulatory and commercial matters Lead and further develop the company’s data protection and privacy framework, ensuring compliance with GDPR and other applicable privacy requirements Provide expert guidance on GDPR and privacy matters, including DPIAs, data processing agreements, international data transfers and privacy risk assessments Advise on AI-related privacy and data protection matters, including AI vendor assessments, AI use cases and the EU AI Act Provide legal guidance across corporate, commercial, employment-related and regulatory matters, balancing legal risk with business objectives Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, vendor agreements and other key legal documentation Identify and manage legal and regulatory risks, supporting appropriate risk mitigation and compliance measures Support corporate governance and monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments affecting the business Partner with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel on legal, privacy, compliance and risk matters Promote a strong culture of legal compliance, privacy, ethics and responsible decision-making across the organization ⭐ You will be successful in this role if you: See Legal as a business partner, not only as a control function Know how to balance legal risk, regulatory requirements and commercial realities Are equally comfortable with strategic topics and hands-on legal work Can make complex privacy and legal topics clear and actionable Enjoy working across countries, functions and cultures, taking ownership in an evolving environment If you would be interested in joining the Optimapharm team, please send your CV and note that only shortlisted candidates who meet the requirements will be contacted for the further selection process. review_candidates.description: Job ID: 9802 Date Posted: October 14, 2026 Join the Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) team, where you'll contribute to groundbreaking innovations! SDL is a University Affiliated Research Corporation that performs cutting edge research and development for the Space Force and associated government agencies, specializing in developing new and untested space-based technologies. We are seeking a GNC Controls Engineer to join our Strategic & Military Space Division and lead the development, test, and deployment of control systems for satellites and space-based components. The ideal candidate would have experience leading the design of satellite control systems including analysis, requirements derivation, algorithms, electrical, and mechanical, as well as contribute to teams working software, and systems engineering. This is an opportunity to play a strong technical design and leadership role and oversee controller designs in support of important, space-based US government missions. The Strategic & Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities. Key Responsibilities Owns the controller component of a major spacecraft subsystem (e.g., Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS), propulsion, or gimbaled instruments) on satellites developed by SDL or external vendors Develops and maintains a comprehensive, multidisciplinary understanding of the owned component, including its design, functionality, interfaces, and integration within the broader spacecraft system Develops, interprets, and manages technical requirements to ensure the component meets mission objectives and overall system requirements Oversees controller and associated avionics development activities to ensure compliance with technical requirements, performance expectations, and program objectives. Collaborates across engineering disciplines to ensure component designs, interfaces, and implementations meet the rigorous performance and reliability standards required for spaceflight Performs design changes and analysis as needed Tracks issues using JIRA and works with programs to implement improvements Participates in mission and systems level program reviews providing technical expertise, design assessments, and status updates Prepares, reviews and presents technical documentation, including analyses, design documentation, development plans, and other engineering deliverables Required Qualifications: Master’s or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent qualifications and experience At least 7 years of experience in controller design and implementation, including a minimum of 4 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner Demonstrated experience designing controllers for aerospace applications Experience overseeing the full controller development lifecycle, including algorithms, modeling, electrical design, software development, mechanical design, systems engineering, integration, and checkout Experience integrating controllers into larger products or systems as a subsystem-level component Experience designing and implementing high bandwidth real time control systems Experience developing, documenting, and overseeing the implementation and verification of requirements for controllers and related aerospace systems Experience using MATLAB/Simulink for controller design, modeling, simulation, and technical analysis Working knowledge of classical spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) principles Working knowledge of current hardware technologies and controller design approaches used in space systems Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing, with program management, customers, contractors, and cross-functional engineering teams U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain a government security clearance Ability to travel occasionally to contractor and customer facilities Preferred Qualifications Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering with a concentration in Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) or Controls, or a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a background in aerospace engineering At least 10 years of experience in space-based control systems, including a minimum of 5 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner Experience in one or more of the following technical areas: Propulsion Astrodynamics / Orbital Mechanics Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) Attitude Dynamics and Controls (ADC) Spacecraft Navigation / Orbit Determination Spacecraft Guidance / Optimization Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Simulation and Test Experience with Atlassian tools, including Confluence, JIRA, and Bitbucket Knowledge of software implementation on FPGAs Experience with software development using C++ Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance Experience developing controllers for the Department of War (DoW) or other government agencies Salary Range $105,000 - $180,000 Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all US locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process. Why Join SDL? SDL offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Visit our Benefits Page to learn more about what we offer. SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success. At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners. The application window for this position is expected to remain open for approximately 7 days; however, it may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. We encourage interested candidates to submit their applications promptly. For questions, assistance, or accommodation with the application process or the DoD SkillBridge program, please contact employment@sdl.usu.edu.
